text: Arawn is a Welsh god. He is the lord of Annwn, the Welsh Otherworld. His world is a typical Celtic Otherworld. It is beautiful and unchanging, without pain, death, or disease. Its residents pass their time in merrymaking and games. Arawn owned a magical cauldron. It suggests a parallel with the Irish father god, the Dagda. Arawn had magical pigs, another motif of the Dagda. He gave the pigs as a gift to the mortal king Pryderi. When the bard Gwydion stole them, he was caught and prisoned in Annwn. Three magical animals of Arawn were stolen by the obscure god Amaethon. The motif holds that domesticated animals once belonged to the gods. People had to bring them to this world by force or trickery. In the Mabinogi tale of Pwyll, Arawn exchanged identities with the mortal king for a year. Pwyll spent his year in the Otherworld and killed Arawn's enemy and rival, Hafgan.
